rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice when appreciating someone’s help, effort, or kindness.

example.english: I really appreciate you helping me move house.
example.jyutping: zan1 hai6 do1 ze6 nei5 bong1 ngo5 bun1 uk1

rows.note: Use this when valuing something by cherishing it and not taking it for granted, such as time or opportunities.

example.english: We should appreciate the time we have to eat together.
example.traditional: 我哋要珍惜一齊食飯嘅時間。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zan1 sik1 jat1 cai4 sik6 faan6 ge3 si4 gaan3

rows.note: Use this instead of 珍惜 when the focus is regarding something as important or valuable rather than cherishing it emotionally.

example.english: I appreciate how seriously the company takes employees’ opinions.
example.traditional: 公司好重視員工嘅意見。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 hou2 zung6 si6 jyun4 gung1 ge3 ji3 gin3

rows.note: Use this when appreciate means understanding or being fully aware of a situation or its importance.

example.english: I appreciate how much pressure you’re under right now.
example.traditional: 我明白你而家有幾大壓力。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ming4 baak6 nei5 ji4 gaa1 jau5 gei2 daai6 aat3 lik6
